name: @activepieces/piece-letmepost
description: Publish and schedule posts to Bluesky, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, and TikTok through one API

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.letmepost.dev` for the hosted service, or your own origin when self-hosting.

api_key.description: Your letmepost API key (`lmp_live_…` or `lmp_test_…`). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

publish_post.name: publish_post
publish_post.description: Publish or schedule a post to one or more connected accounts

accounts.description: The connected accounts to publish to

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.letmepost.dev` for the hosted service, or your own origin when self-hosting.

api_key.description: Your letmepost API key (`lmp_live_…` or `lmp_test_…`). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

text.description: The post body. Optional when the post is media-only on platforms that allow it.

media.description: Media attachments. Give each item a public URL or an existing letmepost media ID, not both.

url.description: Public URL of the media. Use this or Media ID.

mediaId.description: ID of a media asset already uploaded to letmepost. Use this or URL.

firstComment.description: Posted as the first comment under the published post, where the platform supports it.

publishNow.description: Publish immediately. Turn off to schedule for a future time.

scheduledAt.description: When to publish the post (ISO 8601). Required when Publish Now is off.

profileId.description: Optional profile to attribute this post to.

idempotencyKey.description: Reusing the same key never publishes twice, which makes retries safe.

aiMetadata.description: Sends one body of text and optional media to one or more connected accounts in a single call, either immediately or scheduled for a future time. Use to push content out through letmepost. A schedule time is required when Publish Now is off. Not idempotent unless an Idempotency Key is supplied, in which case replays within 24 hours return the original result.

get_post.name: get_post
get_post.description: Retrieve a single post and its per-target results

postId.description: The ID of the post to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches one post by id, including its status, scheduled and published times, the connected account it went to, and the resulting platform URL. Use to check whether a post published or to read back its details. Idempotent, a read-only lookup.

list_accounts.name: list_accounts
list_accounts.description: List the social accounts connected to your organization

aiMetadata.description: Lists every connected account, returning each id, platform, and display name. Use to discover which accounts are available and to resolve the account id required by Publish a Post. Idempotent, a read-only lookup.

limit.description: Maximum number of media assets to return.

aiMetadata.description: Lists uploaded media assets, returning each id, URL, content type, and size. Use to find an existing media id to reuse in Publish a Post instead of re-uploading. Idempotent, a read-only lookup.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.letmepost.dev` for the hosted service, or your own origin when self-hosting.

api_key.description: Your letmepost API key (`lmp_live_…` or `lmp_test_…`). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.letmepost.dev` for the hosted service, or your own origin when self-hosting.

api_key.description: Your letmepost API key (`lmp_live_…` or `lmp_test_…`). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_published_post.name: new_published_post
new_published_post.description: Triggers when a post is published

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a post reaches the published state, emitting the post id, account, platform, text, publish time, and the resulting platform URL. Use to react to content going live, for example to log it or notify a channel. Polls recent posts and emits each newly published one.

post_event.name: post_event
post_event.description: Triggers instantly when a post changes state (published, failed, rejected, and more)

events.description: Which events to listen for. Leave empty to receive all events.

aiMetadata.description: Fires the moment a post changes state, delivered over a registered webhook rather than polling. Emits the event envelope: id, type (e.g. post.published, post.failed), createdAt, and the event-specific data. Subscribe to specific lifecycle events or leave the selection empty to receive all of them.
